# omada_acl (Data Source)

Looks up one gateway, switch or EAP ACL by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_acl" "home_to_iot" {
  type = "gateway"
  name = "Home to IoT HTTPS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ACL controller ID. Specify either id or name.
- `name` (String) ACL name. Specify either id or name.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.
- `type` (String) ACL surface. Defaults to gateway.

### Read-Only

- `destination_ids` (Set of String)
- `destination_type` (Number)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `lan_to_lan` (Boolean)
- `lan_to_wan` (Boolean)
- `policy` (String)
- `protocols` (Set of Number)
- `source_ids` (Set of String)
- `source_type` (Number)
- `vpn_in_ids` (Set of String)
- `wan_in_ids` (Set of String)
